crossRefs.note: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?
You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
He has walled me about, so that I can’t go out. He has made my chain heavy.
He has walled up my ways with cut stone. He has made my paths crooked.

translations.web: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.
translations.bsb: He has blocked my way so I cannot pass; He has veiled my paths with darkness.
translations.kjv: He hath fenced up my way that I cannot pass, and he hath set darkness in my paths.
translations.asv: He hath walled up my way that I cannot pass, And hath set darkness in my paths.
